method: All 245 complete German source paragraphs and all 224 local notes were read. Individually authored German paragraph explanations and optional premise explanations supply the source-ordered reader, source contexts and source-specific concept reasoning. The English canonical bundle supplies stable identities and citation groupings only, not translated source text. Agency, certainty, polarity, attribution, scope, qualifications and relations were compared against the frozen German edition. No external factual update or native-speaker proofreading is claimed. Hashes bind evidence to authored text and source bodies; they do not independently prove semantic fidelity.

publicCopyReview.scope: All 762 public explanatory blocks: contexts, sequence, definitions, distinctions, reasoning, foundations, relations, trails, transitions and reflections.
publicCopyReview.method: Reviewed direct source explanation separately from internal transformation rationale. Removed removal/preservation workflow language from public copy and avoided redundant theological appendices when the paragraph already explains the premise. Retained source attribution, institutional apology, political oppression, optional reader navigation and all protected qualifications.
